headline: IceCure Reports 83% U.S. Sales Growth for Nine Months Ended September
summary: IceCure Medical reported financial and operational results for the first nine months of the year, showing 83% year-over-year growth in U.S. sales.
why: IceCure Medical develops minimally invasive cryoablation technology for destroying tumors as an alternative to surgical removal.

impacts.name: IceCure Medical
impacts.why: Reporting strong year-over-year sales growth directly reflects operational performance for the publicly traded medical device maker.
